definitions.gloss: communication ability, power to convey a message
definitions.explanation: The ability to effectively convey information, ideas, or feelings to others. Frequently used in business, education, and self-improvement contexts.

examples.japanese: {伝達力|でんたつりょく}を{高|たか}めたい。
examples.english: I want to improve my communication skills.

examples.japanese: プレゼンでは{伝達力|でんたつりょく}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Communication ability is important in presentations.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{伝達力|でんたつりょく}に{優|すぐ}れていて、{複雑|ふくざつ}な{内容|ないよう}もわかりやすく{説明|せつめい}できる。
examples.english: She excels at communication and can explain complex topics in an easy-to-understand way.

notes:
A compound of {伝達|でんたつ} (transmission, communication) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Part of a productive pattern in Japanese where ～{力|りょく} is added to form "ability to do X" nouns.

Very common in business skills discussions, job descriptions, and self-improvement contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}を{高|たか}める: to improve communication ability
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}がある: to have communication ability
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}に{優|すぐ}れる: to excel in communication
- {伝達力|でんたつりょく}を{磨|みが}く: to polish one's communication skills

RELATED ～{力|りょく} WORDS:
- {表現力|ひょうげんりょく}: expressive ability
- {理解力|りかいりょく}: comprehension ability
- {説得力|せっとくりょく}: persuasiveness
- {発信力|はっしんりょく}: ability to communicate outward, information dissemination ability
